Burai - Yatsudama no Yuushi Densetsu.name: Burai: Hachigyoku no Yuushi Densetsu
Burai - Yatsudama no Yuushi Densetsu.summary:
Burai: Hachigyoku no Yuushi Densetsu is a Japanese role-playing game that follows eight heroes brought together by a shared conflict. Travel across a fantasy world, explore towns and dungeons, gather information, and experience the story through individual character scenarios.

Build your party through turn-based battles, improve each hero’s abilities through combat and training, and equip weapons and armor according to their strengths.
